name: Random Movie
overview: A random movie picker for the Jellyfin web UI. Click the dice, pick a genre, a year and a minimum rating, and get a random matching movie from TMDB.
description: Adds a floating dice button to the Jellyfin web UI. It opens a dialog where you can pick a genre, a year and a minimum rating, and the plugin returns a random matching movie from TMDB (including movies that are not in your library). Supports Hungarian and English UI. The TMDB API key stays on the server.

versions.changelog: Fixes plugin settings page registration and adds a more robust web UI injection.
